services.name: Multi plan
modifiers: 1 phone number per location (up to 3 incl.), +$249/location after

included: Their own deployment, own logins, own phone config, own data. Never shared with another client
The brain map: every agent visible, what it did, when
Memory and Teach. Correct the agent once, it stays corrected
Approval gates on anything consequential. Nothing sends itself
Emergency fallback: if the AI fails, calls forward to a human number

icp.dental: A dental practice missing calls after hours or during chair time, one location, front desk already stretched thin. Buying trigger: a missed call on a Friday evening.
icp.restaurant: A restaurant or quick-service kitchen that loses pickup orders during a dinner rush because the phone and the line both need the same two hands.
icp.financial-services: A single advisor or small firm with a real prospect list who needs someone dialing it every day, under real compliance constraints. Not a call center.
icp.hospitality: A hotel or venue group that loses group and event bookings because a planner's RFP sits in an inbox for two days while a competitor answers first.
icp.local-service: A service business (HVAC, detailing, salon, auto shop) that books by phone, has no front desk, and loses jobs to whoever picks up first.

whatWeDoNotDo: No free tiers. A 15-day pilot, then a paid plan
No month-to-month discounting to save a churning account
No unmetered plans. Included minutes are a real, enforced cap
No self-serve signup or payment yet. Every deployment is set up by us
honestLimits: The AI discloses it's an AI whenever asked, and where required by law
It never promises a result, a price outside the published plans, or a timeline we haven't already hit for another client
It never quotes custom pricing. Only the three published plans and their add-ons
If it doesn't know something, it says so and offers a callback from a person instead of guessing
policies: Sailz sells software, not investment, legal, medical, or tax advice. The AI never gives advice outside what a client's own business actually offers
Setup fee is not negotiable. It funds the build week
A 15-day pilot precedes every paid plan; pilot terms live in clients/PILOT-AGREEMENT-TEMPLATE.md
aiDisclosure: This is an AI assistant for Sailz. I can tell you about pricing and plans and get you on a 15-minute call with our team. I'm not able to negotiate custom terms.
